summary: Iteration 31: Tested /api/admin/quota-status endpoint + YouTube quota tracking via ContextVar. All 14 tests passed (1 skipped, unrelated). Endpoint shape, admin-only auth (403 for non-admin, 401 for anon), days clamping (0->1, 100->30), fire-and-forget tracking attribution (admin key ticked +100 units +1 call after /api/search; regular key unchanged), and all static invariants verified.

minor.issue: /health (no /api prefix) is proxied to frontend by k8s ingress in preview → returns HTML not JSON. /api/health works and returns {status:'ok'}. Test was adjusted to skip if non-JSON. Not a regression from this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5082 lines — well over the 700-line rule of thumb. Consider splitting into modules (auth, youtube, quota, admin, etc). Not a blocker for this iteration but tech debt is compounding.

quota_status endpoint is registered on the raw `app` (not api_router) as intended per the PR — this bypasses any api_router-scoped middleware (logging/rate-limit) if any is added later. Worth documenting inline.

Fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task in _yt_execute is unawaited — task exceptions are logged via _record_yt_quota's try/except but the task ref is discarded. If the event loop shuts down between execute and task run, writes may be lost. Acceptable for telemetry, but note it.
test_credentials: adrian@affilitube.com / admin123! (admin); throwaway quotatest-{ts}@example.com / pass1234 (created per-run).
seed_data_creation: Creates one throwaway non-admin user per test run (email quotatest-{ts}@example.com). No cleanup — cheap and unique per timestamp.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses key 'token' (not 'access_token'). Register endpoint schema is {email,password,trial?} — no full_name field. YouTube search endpoint is /api/search (not /api/channels/search) — SearchFilters payload with niche/keywords/... . /api/admin/quota-status is registered on `app` directly, not api_router. Only 5 real callsites of get_youtube_service (not 6 as PR description said) — all pass user arg correctly.
